title: Look back at the week
pitch: About 3 minutes. Looking back on purpose shows you progress you'd otherwise miss, and turns one hard moment into something to try next week.

cards.prompt: About 3 minutes. Looking back on purpose shows you progress you'd otherwise miss, and turns one hard moment into something to try next week.
How do you feel right now?
cards.why: A number now gives you a baseline to compare with next week.

cards.prompt: What went well this week, even something small?
cards.why: Small wins are easy to forget, and noticing them shows you what's working.
A few words give you a quick read you can compare week to week.
Picking one moment keeps it specific enough to learn from.

cards.prompt: What did you do with it, and how did that go?
cards.why: Looking at your own move is the part you can change.

cards.prompt: What's one thing you want to try next week?
cards.why: One small, clear step is far more likely to happen than a big plan.

cards.prompt: How do you feel right now?
cards.why: Comparing with the start shows you what looking back did.
